events.title: 충남 천안 용두리에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born in Yongdu-ri, Cheonan, South Chungcheong
events.description_en: She was born in Yongdu-ri, Byeongcheon Township, Cheonan, in South Chungcheong Province.

events.title: 이화학당에 장학생으로 편입하다
events.title_en: She entered Ewha Haktang on a scholarship
events.description: 선교사의 추천으로 서울 이화학당 보통과 3학년에 장학생으로 편입했다.
events.description_en: On a missionary's recommendation she transferred into the third year of the general course at Ewha Haktang in Seoul, on a scholarship.

events.title: 서울 만세시위에 참여하다
events.title_en: She joined the March First protests in Seoul
events.description: 3월 1일 서울에서 일어난 만세시위에 이화학당 학생으로 참여했다. 나흘 뒤 남대문 앞 시위에도 나갔다.
events.description_en: As a student at Ewha Haktang she joined the independence protests that broke out in Seoul on March 1. Four days later she also took part in a demonstration in front of Namdaemun.

events.title: 휴교령으로 천안으로 내려가다
events.title_en: She went home to Cheonan when schools were shut down
events.description: 총독부가 휴교령을 내리자 학교를 나와 고향 천안으로 내려갔다. 그곳에서 만세운동을 준비했다.
events.description_en: When the Government-General ordered schools closed, she left Seoul and went back to her hometown of Cheonan. There she began preparing a demonstration of her own.

events.title: 아우내 장터 만세운동을 이끌다
events.title_en: She led the demonstration at Aunae Market
events.description: 아우내 장터에 모인 군중과 함께 만세를 불렀다. 헌병의 발포로 부모가 그 자리에서 숨졌고, 그는 주동자로 붙잡혔다.
events.description_en: She led a crowd gathered at Aunae Market in shouting for independence. Military police opened fire, killing her parents on the spot, and she was arrested as the organizer.

events.title: 공주지방법원에서 징역 5년을 선고받다
events.title_en: She was sentenced to five years by the Gongju District Court
events.description_en: In the first trial, at the Gongju District Court, she was sentenced to five years in prison.

events.title: 경성복심법원에서 징역 3년으로 감형되다
events.title_en: Her sentence was reduced to three years on appeal in Seoul
events.description: 경성복심법원 2심에서 징역 3년으로 감형됐다. 이후 서대문형무소로 옮겨져 복역했다.
events.description_en: On appeal at the Seoul Appellate Court her sentence was reduced to three years. She was then transferred to Seodaemun Prison to serve it.

events.title: 옥중에서 3·1운동 1주년 만세를 외치다
events.title_en: She led a prison protest on the first anniversary of March First
events.description: 서대문형무소 안에서 3·1운동 1주년을 맞아 동료 수감자들과 함께 만세를 불렀다. 이 일로 더 심한 고문을 받았다.
events.description_en: Inside Seodaemun Prison, on the first anniversary of the March First Movement, she led fellow inmates in shouting for independence again. She was tortured more severely for it.

events.title: 서대문형무소에서 옥사하다
events.description: 거듭된 고문과 영양실조를 견디지 못하고 서대문형무소에서 숨졌다. 열여덟 살이었다.
events.description_en: She died in Seodaemun Prison, her body unable to withstand repeated torture and malnutrition. She was eighteen.
